작품.제목: 1677 Gérard de Lairesse - Diana
작품.설명: Selene and Endymion. Cupido holding a burning torch shows Selene (or Diana) the sleeping Endymion. Behind her the moon shines through the clouds. Mantlepiece commissioned between 1678 and 1682 for the bedchamber of Mary Stuart , later queen of England, at the hunting lodge of her husband, William III of Orange, the present Soestdijk Palace . For the two other surviving paintings by de Lairesse from this bedchamber, see File:Gerard de Lairesse 001.jpg and File:Gérard de Lairesse - Mercurius gelast Calypso om Odysseus te laten vertrekken.jpg .

Bark Brontes and U.S. ship Decatur are the vessels. Caption on image: Peiser 15. Battle of Seattle, 1856. Copyrighted C. Hanford 1895. Caption to the right of bottom left photo: Seattle from Madison Street to Union in 1870. The prominent buildings are Woodwards warehouse, Amos Brown's dwelling, M.P. Church, Central School, University, John Denny, W.H. Shoudy and other dwellings. Caption on image: Peiser 17, Seattle. Photo on top left: Photograph of painting depicting Piner's Point, vicinity present-day King Street in 1852. Prosch Washington Views Album, page 75 Subjects (LCTGM): Waterfronts--Washington (State)--Seattle Subjects (LCSH): Seattle (Wash.) Prosch attributes the drawing of the Battle of Seattle to Clarence Hanford, but others attribute it to Emily Inez Denny.
